value.rationale: Canonical positive-definite Turán optimization for the Hamming distance-two relation, across infinitely many nonbinary finite alphabets and dimensions. The complete optimizer-face theorem (unique radial except \(d\equiv2\pmod q\), where a full-dimensional (\(d-1\)) polytope of nonradial optima appears) is a structural arithmetic transition, not merely evaluation of known Krawtchouk numbers. Exact universal inequalities and attaining families serve equality/stability analysis; meaningful without a downstream theorem. Boundary \(d\ge2q\) is forced by the interior active/inactive swap method, and low-d scope is openly limited.
